lessons.desc: QA guard: price out of range
Harvest filter miss: multi-branch chains (Namq, Wooden) slipped through — signature research now double-checks branch count
Signature rule: only sourced items with real prices go on demo pages; price-unknown items stay off (never invent)
Dedup upgrade: accent/containment fuzzy matching (Salam Café vs Salam Cafe, Breehant vs Breehant Roastery)
Fleet guard: workflow args may arrive as JSON string — parse both forms and refuse to run with an empty target list (silent no-op caught twice)
Session web-search budget is finite (200/session) — size research fleets within budget; agents must return found:false when starved, never invent

lessons.lesson: Delivery apps (HungerStation/Jahez) 403 direct fetches — harvest dishes/prices from search SNIPPETS + fetchable aggregators (ksamenus.com, cafesriyadh.com, menus-sa, tayarmedia, restaurant guru, sao.sa). Collect photo-lead URLs for Mac-side download instead of fetching images here.

MacBook photo pipeline (verified): cafes’ own sites (Zid stores, WordPress, S3) + delivery/social og:image covers ARE fetchable on Mac; Instagram/TikTok are login/JS-walled (no yt-dlp = no video frames). Menus use 11 SHARED category keys at dist/assets/photos/.jpg via hasimg>; ONE real photo per key upgrades ALL luxe menus (no per-cafe slot in current template). Harvested 127 real photos from 52 cafes -> filled 10/11 keys; tea had no clean source so it stays illustrated (never fake it).
loading=lazy on a display:none img never loads (no box, never intersects) so onload/hasimg never fires — photo slots must load eagerly; hidden state via display toggle is fine only without lazy.

Detective panel verdict: data-elite is not visual-elite — emoji/SVG icons in signature cards read as placeholders and shared archetype items are recognizable across sibling menus. True purple needs per-cafe dish photos (Mac photo mission priority = the 16 purple cafes). Also caught: standard-tier medallion showed Latin initial in AR mode (fixed).

Renderer v5 (from recovered Beyt+RUSTIC masters): real Google Fonts work on the LIVE site (visitor browser loads them). Per-cafe font pairs, light-paper vs dark-world moods, motifs, entrance flavors, greetings, real-handle footers — personality per cafe, deterministic, zero invented facts.
Chrome breaks background-clip:text when transformed child spans animate inside — apply gradient class only after word entrance ends, then unwrap spans
